panelUpdateReason.no-installation: The panel was not installed by the Dockge2 installer.
panelUpdateReason.updater-missing: The updater is not installed on the host.
panelUpdateReason.unsupported: The panel cannot tell whether it can update itself.
panelUpdateReason.unreadable: Docker did not answer, so the panel cannot tell how it is installed.
panelUpdateReason.updater-outdated: The updater installed on the host is older than this panel. One update from the host enables updating from the web interface.
panelUpdateReason.no-result: The updater stopped without reporting a result.
panelUpdateReason.exit-mismatch: The exit status of the updater does not match its report.
panelUpdateReason.version-mismatch: The updater reported success, but the panel answers with another version.
panelUpdateReason.helper-removed: The updater container is gone, so nothing can confirm what happened.
panelUpdateReason.contradiction: The status of the panel contradicts the result this page remembered.
panelUpdateReason.lost: The check stopped without a result. Check the update again.

panelUpdateLine.submitting: Sending the request to the panel.
panelUpdateLine.downloading: Downloading and verifying the new version.
panelUpdateLine.ready: The new version is downloaded. The panel stops next.
panelUpdateLine.snapshot: Saving a snapshot of the panel data.
panelUpdateLine.verifying: The new version started; checking that it works.
panelUpdateLine.rolling-back: The new version did not start; Dockge2 {from} is coming back. Restoring the data snapshot may take a few minutes.
panelUpdateLine.step-unknown: The updater reports a step this page does not know. Waiting for the result.
panelUpdateLine.offline-submitting: The panel does not answer; the request may not have arrived.
panelUpdateLine.offline-preparing: Connection lost; the update continues on the server.
panelUpdateLine.offline-verifying: The new version started; waiting for it to answer.
panelUpdateLine.need-auth: The new version asks you to sign in again. The update is being checked.
panelUpdateLine.overdue: The panel has not answered for a long time. The page keeps trying; you can check the state on the host.
panelUpdateLine.quiet: No news from the updater for a while. You can check the state on the host.

panelUpdateOutcome.recovery-required: The update needs attention on the host
panelUpdateOutcome.unknown: The result of the update is unknown

panelUpdateResult.failed-before-cutover: The update stopped before the panel was stopped. Nothing changed.
panelUpdateResult.recovered: The new version did not become ready, so the previous one was started again.
panelUpdateResult.recovery-required: The updater could not bring the previous version back.
panelUpdateResult.unknown: Nothing confirms how the update ended.

stabilityCountLink_attention: Show the stacks that need attention
stabilityCountLink_unknown: Show the stacks in an unknown state
